description: SessionStart (no matcher: startup, resume, /clear and /compact alike, since /clear and /compact wipe context the same way) runs bin/session-start.mjs, which answers the CRITICAL AskUserQuestion interaction rule as a hook JSON object (additionalContext). Stop runs bin/stop.mjs, which blocks a main-session turn that ends in a plain-text question once and points back at that rule; subagents are never gated.
